shared_elements: bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
paired lobed or curved arc forms flanking a central axis
horizontal band(s) of ornament crossing the body
anthropomorphic figure with elaborated headdress zone
paired rectangular/geometric elements in the upper (head) register
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented, strictly axially symmetric reliefs in which an upper register of paired rectangular/head elements sits above a torso zone containing a prominent circular disc, flanked by repeated curved lobes and crossed by horizontal banding — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The decisive difference is the manner and density of rendering: A is a heavily weathered, sparse, shallow incision on a massive stone block seen in a photograph, whereas B is a crisply drawn, densely packed figure with legible limbs, beaded ornaments and fingers, so the two read quite differently as wholes.
